subject: [video] WP09 follow-up commit bb25475 (ASan/UBSan on dump test; sizes)
body: Small follow-up to WP09 DONE: commit bb25475 adds -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined to the C dump utility that check_vectors.sh compiles (the only C in this package), and refreshes the measured size in STATUS. Re-ran from an empty build/WP09: 'bash gpu/video/vectors/check_vectors.sh' -> N2TEST WP09 PASS 152/152, 11.2 s, and 'du -sb gpu/video/vectors' -> 181897 bytes. Review bab018a3 or bb25475; bb25475 is the final tree. No other changes; still no phone/iOS code in this package. Standing by for review requests.
